identity/test_tenant_permissions.py (site-backed, 22 tests OK): taxpayer A cannot list/read/write taxpayer B records, create records for B/another tenant/no taxpayer, or move own record to B; same taxpayer_id in another tenant is invisible; staff and service confined to member tenants (read/write/create); no-membership user sees nothing; disabled membership/tenant removes access; DocShare across taxpayer/tenant rejected; service identity refused every human-only decision action; auditor/specialist cannot approve, supervisor cannot approve own proposal, taxpayer cannot propose; operator gets no decision bypass; portal returns only own fixture submissions and 404 for another taxpayer's, 403 for officers/Administrator.
